mcpInviteCopied: Prompt copied: paste it into your AI agent
moveToolbarHint: Dock toolbar at the top or bottom: drag, or click then choose a position. Arrow keys change dock; double-click or Home resets it.
toolbarDockGuide: Choose a highlighted position at the top or bottom · Esc to cancel

mcpWhereConfig: Add to {{file}}, then restart the client:

mcpExample2: Turn this process into a flowchart with start, end and decision steps.
mcpExample3: Join my live session and add the missing database to the board.

welcomeTagline:
Your drawings are saved in the browser.
Save to file regularly to avoid losing them.
aboutDescription: A lightweight, zero-dependency whiteboard for your browser.
elementSearchPlaceholder: Search by type, text, or color…
hintSelect: Click to select · Drag for marquee · [[Del]] to delete
hintHand: Drag to pan · Scroll to zoom · [[Space]] also pans
hintEraser: Drag over elements to erase them
hintRectangle: Drag to draw · Hold [[Shift]] for a square
hintEllipse: Drag to draw · Hold [[Shift]] for a circle
hintLine: Click to add points · Double-click to finish
hintArrow: Click to add points · Double-click to finish
hintFreehand: Draw freely · Release to finish the stroke
hintSticky: Click to place a sticky note · [[Esc]] to cancel
tipShortcuts: Press {{key}} to see all keyboard shortcuts
tipPalette: {{key}} opens the command palette: every action, by name
tipSearch: {{key}} finds an element by its text
tipShapeLabel: Double-click a shape to write inside it
tipFit: {{key}} fits the whole diagram in view
tipLibrary: {{key}} opens the library of shapes and icons
tipPan: Hold {{key}} and drag to move around the board
tipLive: Draw together: ⋯ More tools, then Start live session
tipMcp: {{key}}, then Connect AI agent: let Claude, Codex or Gemini draw for you
tipHideUi: {{key}} hides the interface for a clean view
hintCurve: Click to add control points · Double-click to finish
hintPolygon: Click to add vertices · Double-click to close
reportDesc: Describe what's not working: we'll open a public issue on GitHub.
reportValidationError: Title and description are too short.
reportSubmitError: Couldn't send the report. Please try again later.
reportSuccessDesc: Thanks, we opened a public issue on GitHub:
hintShape: Drag to draw the selected flowchart shape. Pick another one in the Library [[I]]
libraryImportHint: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud: download the official ZIP and import it here. Icons stay in this browser; use them under the vendor's terms.
libraryDeletePackConfirm: Delete the “{name}” icon pack from this browser? Diagrams that already use its icons keep them.
libraryStorageError: Icon packs can't be stored in this browser.
whatsNewDesc: AI agents can now draw with you, and Markasso suggests what to try next.
whatsNewAgents: Claude, Codex, Gemini and local models create and edit diagrams through MCP. Menu → Connect AI agent has the setup for each client.
whatsNewAgentLive: In a live session, ⋯ More tools → Invite AI agent copies a prompt that brings your agent onto the board.
whatsNewTips: After a short pause, a tip suggests a shortcut or a feature you have not used yet. Turn tips off in Preferences.
cloudDetailSaved: All changes are saved to the cloud.
cloudDetailPending: Your changes will be saved in a moment.
cloudDetailSyncing: Saving your changes to the cloud.
cloudDetailReadOnly: You can view this board. Duplicate it to make your own copy.
cloudDetailOffline: Your changes stay here and upload as soon as you are back online.
cloudDetailRevoked: Open the board again from a valid edit link to keep editing.
cloudDetailTooLarge: Remove some content, or save it as a .markasso file instead.
cloudDetailMissing: It may have been deleted or expired.
cloudConflictDetail: It was edited on another device while you were working. Choose which version to keep.
cloudKeepMineHint: Overwrite the cloud with your version.
cloudTakeTheirsHint: Load the latest version. Your changes are discarded.
cloudSaveCopyHint: Keep both. Your version becomes a new cloud board.
cloudPublicDetail: Anyone with the read link can see this board. Keep the edit link private: whoever has it can change the board.
cloudStorageDetail: The licence key could not be stored. Allow this site to use storage, then try again.
cloudDetailCheckConnection: Check your connection, then try again.
cloudLicenseNeeded: Saving to the cloud needs a Markasso Cloud licence. Paste your key to continue.
cloudKeyStored: A cloud licence key is stored in this browser.
cloudSlow: Too many requests. Please slow down; retry in one minute.
cloudLeaveLive: Open the board outside the live room before saving to cloud.
cloudPagePitch: Your boards in sync between the browser and the Mac app. No account.
cloudPageLinks: The read link shows your board. The edit link lets anyone with it change the board.
cloudPagePublic: Cloud boards are public by link. Keep the edit link private.
cloudPageApps: The web app and the Mac app
cloudPageUnlock: Create and save cloud boards from the web and the Mac app. No account needed.
cloudPageEmail: Lemon Squeezy emails your licence key after purchase. Paste the same key in both apps:
cloudPageLost: Lost your key? Find it in your Lemon Squeezy receipt email or in My orders.
